summary: A long track record and a 24 hour reply promise are strengths, but a contact page with no form and links to the wrong place appear to cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: The page says to fill out the form below, but no form appears, and the email, How to find us and Contact links all point to a map page.
findings.cost: A person who wants to reach a family lawyer cannot easily do it.
findings.fix: A working enquiry form and correct email and map links.

findings.problem: The address shows two postal codes, M4W 1H7 and M4W 3L4, and the firm appears as Gottlieb Family Law Professional Corporation, Gottlieb Law Firm and Gottlieb Family Law.
findings.cost: Mixed details confuse clients and hurt local search.
findings.fix: One address and one firm name.

findings.problem: A menu item reads Mary Elizabeth Lam but links to a page named mira-pilch, and the FAQ shows empty bullet points and a stray Main Page label.
findings.cost: Wrong links and leftover text make a law firm look careless.
findings.fix: Correct team links and a clean FAQ.

findings.problem: The page claims 60 years of experience, but the Our Reviews and Cases sections show no content, and the cost FAQ gives no fee information.
findings.cost: Clients choose on proof and clear fees, and see neither.
findings.fix: Visible reviews, case summaries and fee guidance.

redesign: A working enquiry form and correct email and map links.
One address, one firm name and correct team links.
Visible reviews, case summaries and clear fee guidance.
